name: Entityqueue Form Widget
description: A handy module to populate a form element in the sidebar of node's add and edit pages to allow editors to add content to entityqueues directly from add/edit forms.
project_description:
Populate a form element in the sidebar of node's add and edit pages to allow editors to add content to entityqueues directly from add/edit forms.

 Dependency: 
 
 Entityqueue 
 
 
 
 Enable the module 
 Configure a Content Type with an Entity Queue 
 Go to the create content for the configured content type 
 Notice the Entityqueues field group in the sidebar 
 Expand the Entityqueues field group to see the list. 
 Choose from the available entityqueues below to push this content to. 
 To reorder and manage each queue, please visit the Entityqueue management page
